rows.commentary: 0.3: Jai Moondra targets the channel, and Michael van Lingen quietly pats the ball down into the off-side toward cover point.
0.4: Jai Moondra searches for swing with a fuller length, forcing Michael van Lingen to angle his bat face down and block it back toward mid-on.
0.5: Jai Moondra angles a full delivery into Michael van Lingen, who nudges it away toward mid-on while hunting for early movement.
0.6: Jai Moondra induces a flashing edge from Michael van Lingen that races rapidly between the keeper and slip cordon for a fortunate boundary.
1.1: Byron McDonough strikes early as Louren Steenkamp flashes a half-hearted pull at a short ball down leg, feathering an edge through to wicketkeeper Lorcan Tucker.
1.2: Byron McDonough drifts a fuller delivery down leg past the swinging bat of Jan Frylinck, prompting the umpire to signal a wide.
1.2: Byron McDonough bowls a tight line, and Jan Frylinck simply dead-bats the ball down into the off-side turf.
1.3: Byron McDonough drops it short outside off, allowing Jan Frylinck to latch onto the pull and hammer it down to deep square for four.
1.4: Byron McDonough bangs it in, and Jan Frylinck mistimes an aerial pull that narrowly clears the fielder at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
1.5: Byron McDonough bowls a wide to Jan Frylinck.
1.5: Byron McDonough strays wide outside off, and Jan Frylinck ruthlessly drags the pull shot behind square to race away for four.
1.6: Byron McDonough delivers to Jan Frylinck, who steers the ball firmly behind square on the off-side to rotate the strike with a single.
2.1: No run for Jan Frylinck off Jai Moondra.
2.2: Jai Moondra pitches it on a length and extracts subtle movement away past Jan Frylinck's outside edge, eliciting a loud appeal that the umpire dismisses instantly.
2.3: Jai Moondra drops it on a length at the stumps, and Jan Frylinck steps squarely behind the line to dead-bat it back.
2.4: Jai Moondra angles a short-of-length delivery outside the off stump, nipping inward just enough for Jan Frylinck to watch it sail by.
2.5: Jan Frylinck does not score off Jai Moondra.
2.6: Jai Moondra targets the back of a length outside off, where Jan Frylinck calmly pats it down toward the point region.
15.3: Andy McBrine tosses it up, and Jan Frylinck push-drives it wide of the bowler's right hand to take a single.
15.4: Andy McBrine floats up a delivery, prompting Gerhard Erasmus to stride forward and play a defensive stroke.
15.5: Gerhard Erasmus goes for the drive, slices an edge that drops safely in front of the rushing deep cover fielder, and scampers back for two.
15.6: Andy McBrine attacks the stumps, allowing Gerhard Erasmus to nudge it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
16.1: Gavin Hoey drops it short, inviting Gerhard Erasmus to punch off the back foot down to deep cover for a single.
16.2: Gavin Hoey tosses one up on the sticks, catching an inside edge off Jan Frylinck's defensive push down to mid-wicket for one.
16.3: Gavin Hoey drags his length short, and Gerhard Erasmus pulls the ball away straight to mid-wicket.
16.4: Gavin Hoey fires in a skiddy, flatter delivery that beats Gerhard Erasmus's attempted paddle outside the line of impact.
16.5: Gavin Hoey extracts lovely loop and turn, leaving Gerhard Erasmus beaten entirely on the outside edge during a defensive prod.
16.6: Gavin Hoey darts a flatter one across, which Gerhard Erasmus stabs down into the off-side to rotate the strike.
17.1: Gerhard Erasmus drops back to read Andy McBrine's turn, neatly tucking it down to long-on for a single.
17.2: Andy McBrine tosses it up once more, and Jan Frylinck meets it solidly to defend it straight back down.
17.3: Andy McBrine draws Jan Frylinck forward on the defensive, zipping past the outside edge.
17.4: Andy McBrine floats this one up as Jan Frylinck dances down the track, clipping it straight to mid-on.
17.5: Andy McBrine tosses it outside off, inviting Jan Frylinck to stab it firmly down toward point.
17.6: Andy McBrine drops it short, allowing Jan Frylinck to hang back and slap it wide of cover for a brisk couple before long-off cleans it up.
18.1: Gavin Hoey drifts one into Gerhard Erasmus, who picks up a comfortable two runs out to deep backward point.
18.2: Gavin Hoey serves it up to Gerhard Erasmus, who launches it all the way down to long-on for a boundary.
30.4: Byron McDonough digs it in short on middle, Jan Frylinck leans forward for a heave, miscuing it straight to mid-wicket before an errant throw leaks an extra run.
30.5: Byron McDonough targets just outside off on a back of a length, and Gerhard Erasmus stays back to tap it towards backward point.
30.6: Byron McDonough fires it back of a length outside off, allowing Gerhard Erasmus to punch it past backward point for a brace before third man cuts it off.
31.1: Curtis Campher serves up a full delivery outside off, and Jan Frylinck steps forward to drive it wide of cover and mid-off, collecting two.
31.2: Curtis Campher digs it short on off, and Jan Frylinck rocks forward to absolutely pulverize a pull shot for a maximum that leaves deep square-leg stranded.
31.3: Curtis Campher lands a good length ball just outside off, prompting Jan Frylinck forward to punch it past cover for a single.
31.4: Curtis Campher pushes a full one just outside off, watching Gerhard Erasmus drive it right back before flashing a wry smile at a mock shy.
31.5: Curtis Campher maintains a tight good length just outside off, where Gerhard Erasmus presses forward to safely defend another dot.
31.6: Curtis Campher attacks the full length on middle, and Gerhard Erasmus responds with a pristine straight drive off the middle that races to the boundary.
32.1: Gavin Hoey tosses it full outside off, catching Jan Frylinck's thick inside edge into his pad for a looping deflection that falls safely with no short-leg in place.
32.2: Gavin Hoey loops it full on off, and Jan Frylinck drops to one knee to unleash a colossal slog-sweep sailing over deep mid-wicket for six.
32.3: Gavin Hoey drops onto a good length on middle and leg, letting Jan Frylinck step back and tuck it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
32.4: Hoey keeps it flat and on a good length outside off, allowing Erasmus to work it off the back foot with a thick outside edge past the diving McBrine at short third man for a brace.
32.5: Hoey darts another flat delivery into middle, met by a back-foot punch from Erasmus past a despairing left-handed dive at extra-cover before sweeper tidies up the single.
32.6: Hoey strikes as Frylinck's valiant 76-run knock spanning ninety deliveries, featuring six fours and two sixes, comes to an abrupt end via a catch taken by Jai Moondra.
33.1: Moondra is greeted by Erasmus with a prompt push out towards the sweeper-cover region for a single.
42.5: Gavin Hoey flights this full delivery on off, and Alexander Volschenk pushes forward with a straight bat to smother it.
42.6: Gavin Hoey targets a length on middle, where Alexander Volschenk sweeps it down to fine-leg for three as Moondra scrambles in vain.
43.1: Byron McDonough finds sharp nip-back into the pads, but the umpire rightly signals it sliding down leg past Alexander Volschenk.
43.2: Byron McDonough strays down leg with a short ball, allowing Alexander Volschenk to glide it expertly to the fine-leg boundary.
43.3: Byron McDonough pitches full outside off, catching the high part of Alexander Volschenk's bat as he pushes back harmlessly to the bowler.
43.4: Byron McDonough offers a full one outside off that Alexander Volschenk edges off the inner half, escaping mid-wicket's desperate dive before Tector cleans it up.
43.5: Byron McDonough gets a fullish delivery on middle past Gerhard Erasmus's shuffle, squeezing out a leg-bye as it heads down leg.
43.6: Byron McDonough hits a short of length on middle, and Alexander Volschenk steps back to nudge a brisk single in front of cover.
44.1: Curtis Campher delivers full outside off, inviting Alexander Volschenk forward to stroke it firmly towards cover.
44.2: Curtis Campher rolls out a slower delivery on a length outside off, pulled away by Alexander Volschenk towards deep square-leg for a single.
44.3: Curtis Campher lands it on a good length outside off, and Gerhard Erasmus opens his bat face to steer it down to third man.
44.4: Curtis Campher drops it short outside off, and Alexander Volschenk punches it violently past a helpless mid-off for four.
44.5: Curtis Campher floats a clever slower delivery on a fuller length outside off, drawing Alexander Volschenk forward into a drive that picks out cover precisely.
44.6: Alexander Volschenk taps a short-of-length slower ball to Campher's right and scampers through with Gerhard Erasmus, beating a desperate direct hit at the bowler's end.
45.1: Jai Moondra drops one full on middle stump, allowing Alexander Volschenk to stride forward and flick it wide of long-on where Tector mops up the single.
45.2: Gerhard Erasmus swivels back on a short delivery down leg, gloving it down to fine-leg to bring up his third ODI hundred with a raised bat and a broad smile.
45.3: Alexander Volschenk clears the boundary off Jai Moondra for six.
45.4: Jai Moondra serves it up again, and Alexander Volschenk pushes it away down towards long-on for a comfortable single.
49.2: Jai Moondra strikes as Alexander Volschenk miscues a short pull shot straight to substitute Jordan Neill at deep mid-wicket, who juggles before securing the catch.
49.3: Jai Moondra fires in another delivery too high for the umpire's liking, signalled wide as JJ Smit misses the pull and Lorcan Tucker collects cleanly.
49.3: Jai Moondra snares a sharp drive off his own bowling from JJ Smit, then fields sharply to prevent further chaos as Lorcan Tucker backs up the erratic shy at the stumps.
49.4: Jai Moondra deceives JJ Smit with a clever slower-ball outside off, leaving the batter slashing thin air.
49.5: JJ Smit capitalises on a low full-toss by lofting it down the ground, where a fumble in the deep by Campher gifts the batting side an extra run.
49.6: JJ Smit shuffles across to tuck a very full delivery to square-leg, sealing a single that brings Namibia's total to a formidable 321.
0.1: Smit opens the bowling with an absolute beauty, nipping off a length to completely bypass Balbirnie's defensive prod.
0.2: Balbirnie pokes tentatively at a length ball, squeezing an inside edge that trickles down to long leg for a single.
0.3: Smit targets the pads with a length delivery, allowing Paul Stirling to softly nudge it into the mid-wicket region.
0.4: Paul Stirling attempts to work a length ball into the leg side but misses the meat of the bat, leaving it to die harmlessly on the pitch.
0.5: Paul Stirling survives a nervous edge off a rearing short ball that flies safely over first slip to race away to the boundary.
0.6: Rising onto his toes, Paul Stirling masterfully masters the bounce of a back-of-a-length delivery to pat it firmly towards cover point.
1.1: Balbirnie does not score off Ruben Trumpelmann.
1.2: Ruben Trumpelmann drops it short and angles it across, leaving Andrew Balbirnie punching at thin air.
1.3: No run for Balbirnie off Ruben Trumpelmann.
1.5: No run for Paul Stirling off Ruben Trumpelmann.
11.4: Jack Brassell attacks the channel with a length ball that darts away sharply, leaving Cade Carmichael grasping at thin air.
11.5: Jack Brassell offers width on a short delivery, and Cade Carmichael taps it securely into the off-side to rotate the strike.
11.6: Jack Brassell watches as Paul Stirling stays leg-side and deftly guides the ball away down to third man for a boundary.
12.1: Max Heingo comes into the attack, and Cade Carmichael gently steers the ball down to third man for a single.
12.2: Max Heingo is greeted by Paul Stirling hoisting a flat slap over the cover region for a comfortable couple of runs.
12.3: Max Heingo drops one in, allowing Paul Stirling to delicately open the bat face and run it down to third man for one.
12.4: Max Heingo angles a length ball into Cade Carmichael, who hangs his bat out defensively and takes an inside edge straight onto the pads.
12.5: Max Heingo delivers another length ball angled in, prompting Cade Carmichael to tuck it safely across to mid-wicket.
12.6: Max Heingo provides width outside off, allowing Cade Carmichael room to square drive firmly down to deep cover for a single.
13.1: Jack Brassell slides in a low full toss that Cade Carmichael clips away firmly in the direction of mid-wicket.
13.2: Jack Brassell rushes Cade Carmichael with pace, forcing the batsman to hurry his defense from right behind the line.
13.3: Jack Brassell watches as Cade Carmichael push drives firmly toward mid-off and scampers across to steal a sharp single.
13.4: Jack Brassell tails one in sharply on a length, finding the bat-pad gap as Paul Stirling flashes and misses completely.
13.5: Jack Brassell slides it into the hips, allowing Paul Stirling to retreat and nudge a single down to deep square leg.
13.6: Jack Brassell strays onto the pads, clipped away by Cade Carmichael wide of deep mid-wicket before a sharp chase cuts off the second run.
14.1: Loftie-Eaton floats this one up invitingly, met by a dead-bat defensive push into the off-side by Paul Stirling.
14.2: Loftie-Eaton drops it up, and Paul Stirling skips down the track to launch a flat maximum soaring over long-on.
14.3: Loftie-Eaton keeps it turning, worked away by Paul Stirling into the mid-wicket region for a single.
14.4: Loftie-Eaton drifts it through, tucked around smartly by Cade Carmichael toward square leg to rotate the strike.
18.6: Max Heingo delivers on a length, and Harry Tector clears room to pat it straight to the fielder stationed at point for a dot ball.
19.1: Loftie-Eaton offers a full toss, which Paul Stirling forcefully slaps away to deep cover to rotate the strike with a single.
19.2: Loftie-Eaton drops it through, and Harry Tector retreats to push the ball down toward long-on for an easy run.
19.3: Loftie-Eaton pushes it through again, and Paul Stirling steps back to punch firmly down to deep cover for a comfortable single.
19.4: Loftie-Eaton slides a low full toss into the pads, allowing Harry Tector to clip it neatly down toward mid-wicket.
19.5: Loftie-Eaton fires in a flatter trajectory, and Harry Tector opens the bat face to stab it down into the turf for a single.
19.6: Loftie-Eaton watches Paul Stirling push drive the ball before diving sharply to his left to make a crucial stop as the keeper shouts down.
20.1: Max Heingo bangs it in short, and Paul Stirling stays inside the line to muscle a massive pull over long leg that seemingly disappears the ball from the ground.
20.2: Max Heingo tempts Paul Stirling with a short delivery outside off, and the batter gets a reprieve as the fielder at point fumbles after getting too close too early.
20.3: Max Heingo targets a fuller length angled into the batter, leaving Harry Tector to clip it securely down toward mid-wicket.
20.4: Max Heingo bowls a length delivery outside off, and Harry Tector flashes a bat at it with a punchy intent but completely misses.
20.5: Max Heingo drops slightly short with an angled delivery, allowing Harry Tector to roll his wrists and pull it behind square for a boundary.
20.6: Max Heingo angles it in, and Harry Tector deadens the bounce into the off-side with yielding wrists.
21.1: Loftie-Eaton pushes a flatter trajectory outside off, allowing Paul Stirling to step backward and slice a delicate boundary fine toward third man.
21.2: Loftie-Eaton loops it up outside off, and Paul Stirling crashes the drive straight into the cover fielder.
21.3: Loftie-Eaton invites the drive with generous flight, and Paul Stirling collects a single down to long-off.
21.4: Loftie-Eaton drops a tossed-up delivery straight onto the stumps, forcing Harry Tector to nudge it defensively back to the bowler.
21.5: Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton pierces the defense with a masterclass delivery, shattering Harry Tector's stumps and ending a six-run knock.
32.4: Ruben Trumpelmann probes tight on off, forcing Curtis Campher onto the back foot to steer it cleanly toward backward point.
32.5: Ruben Trumpelmann tests the batsman with a short-of-length delivery on middle, neatly tucked away into the square-leg region.
32.6: Ruben Trumpelmann offers width outside off, allowing George Dockrell to stride forward and stroke a sweet drive out to sweeper cover.
33.1: Gerhard Erasmus drifts one down leg on a good length, glanced away wide of mid-wicket by George Dockrell for a single.
33.2: Gerhard Erasmus tempts Curtis Campher with a flat length ball outside the leg-stump, carved away past backward point for a couple of runs after a sharp call of a catch.
33.3: Gerhard Erasmus fires it full on middle and leg, met by a forward defensive flick from Curtis Campher straight to mid-wicket.
33.4: Gerhard Erasmus angles one full across off, greeted by a back-foot tap from Curtis Campher just in front of backward point.
33.5: Gerhard Erasmus pitches on a good length on off, punched cleanly wide of extra-cover by Curtis Campher to rotate the strike.
33.6: Gerhard Erasmus zips a quicker delivery into off, tucked toward mid-wicket where a fumble prompts a cautious refusal of the single.
34.1: Max Heingo targets outside off with a length ball, smashed straight to backward point by the flashing bat of Curtis Campher.
34.2: Max Heingo digs it in short on off, but a top-edge off Curtis Campher's pull sails over Zane Green and bounces straight over the ropes for four.
34.3: Max Heingo drops short on middle, punched firmly off the back foot by Curtis Campher down to long-on for one.
34.4: Max Heingo spears this full delivery into off stump, allowing George Dockrell to stride forward and punch it securely toward long-on for a single.
34.5: Max Heingo drops it short around off, forcing Curtis Campher onto the back foot to punch firmly back, only for the timber to block the path.
34.6: Max Heingo attacks the leg stump, forcing Curtis Campher to clear a path and hammer his drive directly to the fielder stationed at backward point.
35.1: Gerhard Erasmus fires this delivery way down the leg side where George Dockrell loses his balance on the sweep, only for Zane Green to fumble a golden stumping opportunity.
35.1: Gerhard Erasmus floats up a slower, fuller teasing delivery outside off, safely smothered back to the bowler by a forward-leaning George Dockrell.
35.2: Gerhard Erasmus delivers into the surface and George Dockrell works it away into the deep mid-wicket pocket to collect a comfortable single.
45.3: Smit tosses it full on middle, and Gavin Hoey steps forward, clears his front leg, and lofts it cleanly over the leaping long-on fielder for six.
45.4: Smit digs it in short and slower on the stumps, allowing Gavin Hoey to pull a top-edge over Zane Green and scamper back for an easy second run.
45.5: Smit fires it full and follows Gavin Hoey outside leg, clipped away into the vacant space wide of deep square-leg for another couple.
45.6: Smit attacks the leg-stump with a full delivery, and Gavin Hoey clears the front leg once more to soar it effortlessly over long-on for maximum.
46.1: Ruben Trumpelmann delivers back of a length on off, where Jai Moondra steps forward and pulls it firmly wide of long-on for a brisk two runs.
46.2: Ruben Trumpelmann deploys a clever back-of-the-hand slower ball on a length outside off, leaving Jai Moondra swinging through thin air as the ball dies ahead of Zane Green.
46.3: Ruben Trumpelmann pitches short on the stumps, but Jai Moondra brilliantly improvises by backing away to ramp it cleanly over the keeper to the fence.
46.4: Ruben Trumpelmann rushes one in short on off, and Jai Moondra gets forward to pull, slicing it safely in front of a charging deep mid-wicket for two.
46.5: Ruben Trumpelmann slides a low full-toss down leg past a shuffling Jai Moondra, who misses his flick, allowing the batters to hustle through for a leg-bye.
46.6: Ruben Trumpelmann angles it full outside off, and Gavin Hoey sinks low in an ambitious attempt to reverse-sweep, only to miss the ball entirely.
47.1: Gerhard Erasmus fires one far outside off, well past the tramline, prompting the umpire to signal a wide after Jai Moondra leaves it alone.
47.1: Gerhard Erasmus bowls a full outside off, Jai Moondra attempts a forward drive, misses the line, and is caught and bowled by Erasmus for 20 off 19.
47.2: Gerhard Erasmus darts one in sharply down the leg side, past the groping flick of Byron McDonough, allowing a scampered leg bye to sneak through.
47.3: Gerhard Erasmus delivers a flat length ball on middle that Gavin Hoey top-edges on the pull, ballooning safely behind to Jack Brassell for the final wicket to seal a 31-run victory.

preview.text: Ireland won the toss and chose to bowl first against Namibia in the one-day match at Namibia Cricket Ground. The usual first-innings score in the 8 recorded one-day matches at this venue is 238. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 4 per cent chance of rain and about 30 degrees.

summary.text: Namibia won by 31 runs. NAM made 321-6, Gerhard Erasmus (c) top-scoring with 156 off 125 balls; Gavin Hoey took 3 for 53. IRE made 290-10, Paul Stirling (c) top-scoring with 77 off 71 balls; Jack Brassell took 4 for 52. Sides batting first at Namibia Cricket Ground usually make about 238.
